payload.title: Close the grammar-bound deterministic canonicalization gap for CC-WP-02
payload.work_clay: Without modifying the active V17 parser-repair grammar or its current validator, add the smallest deterministic canonical structural serialization and mutation/trivia discriminator required by CC-WP-02. Preserve source order, semantic tokens and Unicode string bytes; remove parser-only NEWLINE/semicolon separator trivia from the canonical payload; bind hashes to grammar/source identities. Execute existing strict/full-corpus validation plus the canonicalizer discriminator on the verified Ubuntu self-hosted runner before any PASS claim.
payload.reason_clay: Current main proves strict parser construction/full-corpus parse-tree determinism but its own scope guard states that grammar-bound canonicalizer/target receipts remain open. Lark strict-mode validates grammar collisions, not semantic canonicalization. RFC 8785 provides an external canonicalization principle: hashes require invariant serialization and Unicode string data must not be silently normalized.
payload.completion_clay: A branch/PR contains a deterministic grammar-bound canonicalizer and focused tests; equivalent horizontal trivia/comments/newline/separator variants hash identically where grammar semantics are unchanged; operator/literal/order mutations hash differently; Unicode string lexemes remain preserved; existing V17 frontend validation still passes; Ubuntu self-hosted runner emits reproducible logs/receipt. CC-WP-02 remains non-PASS unless strict/full-corpus plus canonical roundtrip/hash acceptance receipts are all present.
payload.executor_policy: ChatGPT may implement the isolated canonicalizer/test/workflow lane on a fresh branch. Do not edit the active V17 grammar while another parser-repair lineage may exist. Re-read main before writes. Use PR/self-hosted Ubuntu execution; no paid training/API budget.
invalidators: CC-WP-02 canonical contract is materially revised
